self_review.rule: All DoD items from the sprint contract are addressed
self_review.evidence: <what was done / test output / file reference>

self_review.rule: No NG rule violations: Plans.md untouched (NG-1), no embedded git repos (NG-2), no nested spawn (NG-3)
